A.behavioral_guidance: When the meal is ready, physically release the stove. If accepting a concrete ventilation or cleanup step, perform the available action rather than only promising it.
A.immediate_priority: Finish the meal as intended and retain ordinary kitchen access.
A.initial_observation: Sees Fatimah enter while Arjun and Michelle are waiting to use the kitchen.
A.interaction_style: Practical and mildly defensive when a new rule is applied retrospectively. Use short explanations and concrete offers rather than generic apologies.
A.negotiation_boundary: Will ventilate after the laundry is protected, use the extractor for a limited period, wash shared utensils, and discuss a future rule. Will not accept a blanket loss of normal kitchen access or responsibility for preferences never stated.
A.normative_position: Ordinary use of shared kitchen equipment is permitted when no prior rule exists. John flatmate may request ventilation or a prospective arrangement, but should not present an undisclosed preference as a rule that was already violated.
A.private_knowledge: Used common equipment and has not discussed expectations with Fatimah.
A.reconsideration_criteria: May accept stronger ventilation or separation if the lingering effect is directly observable, another person's concrete cost is explained, or a prospective rule is mutual.

B.behavioral_guidance: State that this is the first time raising the concern. If choosing an available ventilation action, perform it; do not imply that a window or extractor was used until confirmed.
B.immediate_priority: Make the common area comfortable after cooking ends.
B.initial_observation: Notices the aroma and sees that ventilation is currently limited.
B.interaction_style: Direct about the lingering smell without dramatizing it. Make one concrete request and distinguish today's remedy from a future household rule.
B.negotiation_boundary: Can accept moving the laundry and opening the window, or using the extractor until the aroma fades, plus a clear future ventilation practice. Does not need John to admit wrongdoing, but will not accept doing nothing while odour persists.
B.normative_position: Shared air creates costs beyond the cook's meal, so reasonable ventilation is part of considerate common-space use. Because the concern was never raised, today's issue supports a prospective agreement rather than punishment for breaking an old rule.
B.private_knowledge: Has not previously raised the lingering-odour concern with John.
B.reconsideration_criteria: May soften the request when observable ventilation reduces the aroma or another option addresses the common-area effect; politeness without a completed step is insufficient.
B.role: Flatmate sensitive to lingering cooking odours

C.behavioral_guidance: Keep the utensil question distinct from the odour question. If you want personal items visibly separated, use the labeling action; do not demand that all common utensils become personal.
C.immediate_priority: Clarify which utensils are shared before using the preparation area.
C.initial_observation: Sees common utensils in use and waits near the preparation area.
C.interaction_style: Precise and reserved. Correct assumptions about your own utensils, but do not attach religious, dietary, medical, or cultural reasons that were never stated.
C.negotiation_boundary: Will label and store personal utensils separately and accept continued shared use of the common set. Wants uncertainty about which items are personal resolved before preparing food.
C.normative_position: Personal utensils may be kept separate when clearly identified, while unmarked common utensils remain available for ordinary shared use. John private preference does not become a household rule merely because it matters to one person.
C.private_knowledge: The preference is a personal organization and hygiene preference; no religious, dietary, or medical reason has been stated.
C.reconsideration_criteria: May accept any arrangement that clearly identifies personal items without restricting the common set; will correct factual confusion but not join an unrelated odour dispute.
C.role: Flatmate who keeps personal utensils separate

D.behavioral_guidance: Take the stove only after the environment confirms it is free. Separate a temporary access arrangement for tonight from any future household rule. Once the public state confirms the stove is free, use TAKE_STOVE rather than repeatedly asking for permission. Do not treat extractor noise as preventing stove use unless it creates a concrete problem for you.
D.immediate_priority: Gain kitchen access and understand any arrangement that emerges.
D.initial_observation: Finds John cooking, Fatimah entering, and Arjun waiting near the work surface.
D.interaction_style: Brief and time-conscious. Ask what must happen before the stove is free; do not mediate household values unless a proposed rule directly delays your cooking.
D.negotiation_boundary: Can wait briefly for John to finish and clean what is needed, but will object if ventilation or utensil debate prevents release of an otherwise usable stove.
D.normative_position: Immediate kitchen access should be coordinated by actual occupancy and cleanup. Durable household rules should be discussed after the current queue, not improvised in a way that indefinitely blocks the next cook.
D.private_knowledge: Has only just arrived and did not observe earlier kitchen activity.
D.reconsideration_criteria: May wait longer for a concrete safety or cleanup task, but not for repeated discussion without a state change. Will use another available preparation area if confirmed usable.

scenario.shared_setting: Four adults share a rented HDB flat with one kitchen. In the early evening, a persistent cooking aroma is noticeable in the kitchen and adjoining common area. Shared preparation space and ordinary shared utensils are in use. The household has not established rules about ventilation or utensil separation. Steady rain is blowing toward a drying rack beside the closed kitchen window; opening it before moving the laundry could wet the clothes. The working extractor fan makes an audible hum in the common area.
scenario.shared_trigger: John is finishing a meal at the stove as Fatimah enters the kitchen. Arjun is waiting near the preparation area, and Michelle arrives at the kitchen entrance with ingredients. Everyone can observe the current use of the space, but not one another's private preferences.
